 US warship makes second Colombo call this year as military ties deepen
 US warship makes second Colombo call this year as military ties deepen 
 Oct 28, 2026 
 USS Canberra at the port of Colombo on 26 October. Photograph: Sri Lanka Navy 
 The US Navy warship USS Canberra has made its second port call in Colombo this year, as Washington expands military cooperation with Sri Lanka despite the Sri Lankan armed forces’ record of war crimes against Tamils.
 The Independence-class littoral combat ship arrived on 26 October for replenishment and left the following day , according to the Sri Lanka Navy. It previously visited Colombo in June, after taking part in US naval operations in the Arabian Sea.
 The US Navy littoral combat ship USS Canberra. File photograph: US Navy 
 “We appreciate the Sri Lanka Navy’s professionalism and support in making these visits smooth and efficient,” said U.S. Ambassador to Sri Lanka Eric Meyer.
 “Each visit reinforces the strength of our naval partnership, built on trust, and our shared commitment to maintaining security and stability across the Indian Ocean.”
 US and Sri Lankan naval personnel during the CARAT exercise in Trincomalee this year. File photograph 
 Expanding military ties 
 The US has deepened military ties with Sri Lanka this year through helicopters, naval technology and joint exercises. In July, the US Navy trained with Sri Lankan forces in Trincomalee , the site of a notorious Sri Lankan naval torture facility, and the USS Tulsa called at Colombo earlier this month.
 Washington has itself sanctioned senior Sri Lankan commanders. In 2020 it barred the then army chief Shavendra Silva from entering the US over credible information of his involvement in extrajudicial killings, and in 2023 it banned the former navy commander Wasantha Karannagoda over gross human rights violations.
 Rights groups have questioned whether US vetting of Sri Lankan military personnel is keeping out those accused of war crimes . No Sri Lankan commander has been prosecuted in Sri Lanka over atrocities committed during the Mullivaikkal genocide.
